title: The Great Junk Drawer Audit
skyStory: The crescent, nineteen percent lit, settles into Virgo and immediately starts alphabetising the constellations. Virgo has a label maker and is not afraid to use it. The Big Dipper is now filed under D for Dipper, Big. Saturn weeps with joy. Mars has hidden the label maker's spare tape somewhere in Orion's belt and is whistling innocently.

reading: Virgo moon on a Monday means one thing: the junk drawer. You know the one. It holds three mystery keys, a birthday candle, a tiny screwdriver and a mystery cable. Today it gets sorted, and you will find something that makes you laugh out loud.

Life Path 3 can turn even a chore into a show. Narrate the sorting like an antiques appraiser: and here we have a rare twist tie, circa last spring. The [[Eight of Pentacles]] approves of careful work on small things. The cabin feels a full pound lighter by dinner.
joel.mission: Empty one junk drawer completely and appraise each item aloud in a posh auction voice before sorting it.
joel.omen: A rubber band that has been wrapped around something for years. It means an old knot is ready to be untied.

reading: Virgo and Capricorn are earth sign cousins, and today you are both in tidy, competent mode. Someone around you is overwhelmed by a list. You can see in three seconds which item matters. Point to it. Life Path 11 wins again, quietly.

Later, the shore gives you a small gift: a perfectly smooth stone, a sea-glass chip or a shell with no cracks. Keep it on your desk as a reminder that the sea polishes things slowly, and you are being polished too. No rush. The tide does not hurry and neither does the Mountain.
nancy.mission: Help someone pick the single most important item on their list. Then insist they ignore the rest until tomorrow.
nancy.omen: A piece of sea glass or a smooth pebble on a path. It means slow work is beautiful; keep going.

together.text: Each of you sort one small chaotic space today and send a before-and-after photo. Virgo will judge the results with a magnifying glass. The prize is bragging rights and the right to say I am basically a librarian now.

game.intro: Virgo moon, junk drawer audit. Saturn is holding a clipboard over the drawer. Three choices, ten seconds each.
